rv.q: Back when I was a young whipper snapper - which is considerably longer ago than I care to remember - I had a notion that I should like to emulate my hero Alec Guinness and become an actor. To this end, I began a correspondence with him, during which my letters were always addressed to his home “Kettlebrook Meadows”, near Petersfield in Hampshire.
Two Halves Of Guinness is an excellent piece of theatre, well written, well staged and well performed.
The evening moves quickly and never loses its grip.
Two Halves of Guinness is an assured one-man show delivered with empathy and respect.

cn.t: Critics praise this absorbing solo tribute to Alec Guinness as dazzling and engrossing, with Zeb Soanes capturing the legendary chameleon's iconic roles, though the intensely private man behind them remains somewhat elusive.
